product_metadata.title: Walker Edison Farmhouse Barn Door Wood and Glass Fireplace TV Stand for TV's up to 64" Flat Screen Living Room Storage Cabinet Doors and Shelves Entertainment Center, 58 Inch, Rustic Oak
features: Dimensions: 25" H x 58" L x 16" W
Cable management features to run cords in the back of the TV stand
Fireplace display and heat can be turned on individually
Includes electric fireplace that will heat up to 400 sq. ft. (4600 BTU)
No electrician required, as the electric fireplace is a simple plug-in unit
description: Maybe winter is your favorite season. You love snuggly sweaters and snowy nights spent inside watching movies or reading a book next to a glowing fire. You can have that mood any time of the year with this farmhouse TV stand. Turn the 18” fireplace heat on with one switch during cold winter months. During the summer, turn the flames on with another switch to set the cozy mood. And keep cuddly blankets, fuzzy socks, or your favorite book nearby behind the two glass doors on either side of the entertainment console. Whether snow flurry or shine, you can always have the cuddly winter mood around.
